description: This is a satellite imagery map displaying a schematic representation of typical estuary morphology, featuring the Gironde Estuary in France. The image uses a false-colour composite. Land areas on either side of the estuary are shown in reddish-brown tones, characteristic of vegetation or urban areas in infrared composites. The water body itself transitions from a lighter cyan colour within the delineated estuary to a darker blue in the wider coastal waters or sea. A prominent blue line delineates the boundary of the estuary. An island or sandbank is visible in the darker blue water body. The imagery source is Spot 5, with a resolution of 2.5 metres.
